title: Flow MRI in Normal Pressure Hydrocephalus
brief_summary: Normal pressure hydrocephalus diagnosis based on quantitative study of cerebro-spinal fluid and blood flow by phase contrast magnetic resonance imaging.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ventricular dilation seen on morphological magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
* Walking disorder
* Cognitive disorder
* Participants gave their written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contra-indication to MRI
* Obstructive tumoral hydrocephalus
* Curatorship or tutorship
* Pregnancy or lactation
* No social assurance
